update_required_when: destination already publishes a Continuity Vault Kit version, release, install, download, or compatibility claim
destination contains a direct continuity-vault-kit or ContinuityVault artifact reference that becomes stale
destination explicitly declares itself a release mirror or publication surface for this repository
no_update_required_when: destination contains no direct reference to the kit or its release artifacts
destination only discusses general continuity or admissibility concepts without a repository-specific claim
